description: This file contains the implementation of the ActivationCollector class in the Orleans Runtime, responsible for managing grain activation lifecycles, including scheduling, collection, deactivation under memory pressure, and lifecycle integration.

classes.name: ActivationCollector
classes.description: Manages scheduling and deactivation of grain activations based on idleness, memory pressure, and lifecycle events.

classes.name: ActivationCollector.Bucket
classes.description: A bucket that holds activations scheduled for deactivation at a specific ticket time.

methods.name: GetNumRecentlyUsed
methods.description: Returns the number of activations used within a recent time span.

methods.name: CollectActivations
methods.description: Collects all activations that have been idle for at least the specified age limit.

methods.name: ScheduleCollection
methods.description: Schedules a grain context for future collection if it becomes idle.

methods.name: TryCancelCollection
methods.description: Attempts to cancel scheduled collection for a grain activation.

methods.name: TryRescheduleCollection
methods.description: Attempts to reschedule the collection for an activation.

methods.name: MakeTicketFromDateTime
methods.description: Creates a collection ticket based on a DateTime, aligning it to collection quantum boundaries.

methods.name: MakeTicketFromTimeSpan
methods.description: Creates a collection ticket from a timeout duration.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Associates a grain context with a collection ticket and adds it to the corresponding bucket.

methods.name: ScanStale
methods.description: Scans for activations that are stale or idle long enough for collection.

methods.name: ScanAll
methods.description: Scans all buckets for activations idle beyond a specified age limit.

methods.name: IsMemoryOverloaded
methods.description: Checks if the system is under high memory pressure and calculates surplus activation count to deactivate.

methods.name: DeactivateInDueTimeOrder
methods.description: Deactivates a specified number of activations in the order of their scheduled deactivation time.

methods.name: Stop
methods.description: Stops the activation collection loop and memory-based deactivation loop.

methods.name: RunActivationCollectionLoop
methods.description: Main loop that periodically scans and collects stale activations.

methods.name: RunMemoryBasedDeactivationLoop
methods.description: Loop that periodically checks memory pressure and deactivates activations accordingly.

methods.name: CollectActivationsImpl
methods.description: Performs the actual collection of activations, either stale or expired based on parameters.

methods.name: DeactivateActivationsFromCollector
methods.description: Deactivates a list of activations asynchronously.
